newsitem.title: USA: Perini secures $10 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: Perini secures $10 mln in financing.

text.p: Perini Corp said Monday it has secured $10 million in short-term financing by increasing its available bank-credit facility.
The new financing became available through participation under the existing loan by a group of investors led by Richard C. Blum & Associates LP of San Francisco, it said.
As a fee for the financing, the company has issued shares of Perini common stock, with a fair market value of $400,000, to the Blum group.

The financing will be repayable by the company at the completion of the proposed $30 million issuance of a new series of cumulative convertible junior preferred stock to the Blum group or January 31, 1997, whichever is earlier.

In July, Perini announced that the Blum group was to invest $30 million. Initially, the company expected to close the deal in early October. It is now anticipated that the closing will take place in December.
Perini provides general contracting and construction management services for public and private clients.
